downstream_evidence.supports: Downstream WCD9378 enables RX/TX paging_support=true on SoundWire slave devices.
Downstream regmap-SWR selects 4-byte register addressing when paging_support is true.

upstream_evidence.supports: Upstream SDW core fills msg->addr_page1/addr_page2 and msg->page when paging is required.
qcom_swrm_xfer_msg() currently uses msg->addr only and does not explicitly act on msg->page/addr_page1/addr_page2.

reason: A generic qcom paging patch cannot be proven safe from static evidence alone without runtime/controller validation. Implementing controller-side paging handling here could regress existing SoundWire devices; therefore RFC paging-core change is fail-closed for A.1.

runtime_evidence_required: Controller transfer trace with paged accesses
Proof of required/absent qcom controller page handling
No-regression evidence on existing Qualcomm SoundWire users
